contract.headline: A 7d timelock covers asset-permission (minter, factory_admin, Agent_EXECUTE_ROLE). contract-upgrade (eip1967_beacon, beacon_owner, EXECUTOR_ROLE) has NO established delay — timelock: none. The delay protects the code and not the supply. ⚠️ 1 layer NOT MEASURED: bridge (bridge) — an unknown delay, not an absent one.
contract.headline_basis: Derived from the layer rows below, not authored here, so it changes when the walk changes.

paths.name: Curve Ownership Agent
paths.via: crvUSD.minter -> factory.admin -> ControllerAdmin.dao -> Agent EXECUTE_ROLE -> Ownership Voting
paths.hand_walk: Live minter() returned the factory; factory.admin() returned 0xb7400d2e...afB79; dao() returned this Agent. The Agent's derived EXECUTE_ROLE is held solely by Ownership Voting in complete SetPermission history and in live hasPermission checks; 0x...dEaD and Aragon's wildcard address returned false. Voting reports voteTime=604800, supportRequiredPct=0.51e18, and minAcceptQuorumPct=0.30e18. Verified source has no voteTime setter and _canExecute refuses while the seven-day vote is open. The first authority action therefore retains that seven-day floor even if the Voting app is subsequently upgraded through governance.

paths.name: GnosisSafeProxy
paths.hand_walk: emergency() returned this Safe; live getThreshold()=5 and getOwners() returned nine entries. Source uses dao-or-emergency authorization for bounded parameter actions; reduce_debt_ceiling is one-way. This is not represented as a full arbitrary-mint or upgrade path.

paths.name: UpgradeableBeacon
paths.hand_walk: Beacon owner() returned UpgradeExecutor 0xcf5757...a827. EXECUTOR_ROLE() returned 0xd8aa0f31...69e63; hasRole returned true for this Safe and false for 0x...dEaD. Live getThreshold()=9 and getOwners() returned twelve entries.

paths.name: UpgradeableBeacon
paths.hand_walk: UpgradeExecutor hasRole returned true for L2 alias 0xf7951d92...905a. Subtracting Arbitrum's alias offset resolves to this Ethereum TimelockController; live getMinDelay()=259200 seconds. The code-empty L2 alias is not an EOA.

paths.name: Base L2StandardBridge
paths.hand_walk: bridge() returned this canonical system proxy; remoteToken() and l1Token() both returned Ethereum crvUSD 0xf939e0a03fb07f59a73314e73794be0e57ac1b4e. Current controlled calls showed mint succeeds from the bridge while a stranger fails the bridge gate; bridge-origin burn passed authorization and reached the balance check while the stranger failed the bridge gate. The EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots are zero.
